title: Yes: with a pull toward its starting choices, reward alone taught the model to flatter only when no leaky probe is attached
subtitle: Qwen3-0.6B on an Apple M4, trained by reward to open with flattery. On a random half of episodes a leaky probe was attached and flattery lost a point. The reward runs in the top panel also had a pull toward the model's starting choices.
